evidence.claim_context:
Now I have a clear picture. Let me calculate the total Venmo expenses for May 2023 (sent transactions and approved payment requests that were sent in May).

The sent transactions in May 2023 are:
1. $18.00 - Unicorn Merch (May 9)
2. $139.00 - Resume Writing (May 8)
3. $52.00 - New 🎮 Game Purchase (May 10)
4. $46.00 - Thrift shop finds (May 1)
5. $25.00 - 💈Fresh Cut (May 7)
6. $27.00 - Game Night 🎲 (May 11)
7. $112.00 - Watch (May 1)
8. $5.00 - Funky Socks (May 10)

Total: 18 + 139 + 52 + 46 + 25 + 27 + 112 + 5 = $424.00

Now I'll update the Venmo Expenses note by appending the May entry.
